title: Fill placeholders (GitHub repo, Telegram, LinkedIn, site URL, email)
body: README.md, SECURITY.md, docs/index.html, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml. CI blocks main while any `{{…}}` remains.

title: Enable branch protection on main (PR + green CI)
body: Require pull request, require `ci / check`, no force-push.

title: Custom domain for the landing
body: Buy or pick a domain, add CNAME in docs/, set it in Pages settings, enforce HTTPS.

title: Publish launch posts (TG RU, LinkedIn EN, Claude Code community)
body: Drafts are in the project doc. Confirm the 'hasn't gone down since' claim before LinkedIn.

title: Tag v0.1.0 and verify the release zip installs on claude.ai
body: Tag on main → release workflow → download homeport-skill.zip → Settings → Capabilities → Skills → upload → run 'set up my own VPN' in a fresh chat.

title: Translate SKILL.md and references to English
body: The skill body is Russian-only. Claude follows it in any language, but English-speaking contributors can't review it. Keep RU as the source of truth until EN is verified on a real run.

title: Hetzner provisioning parity (create server + DNS via API)
body: Only DigitalOcean is automated. Hetzner is the most-requested alternative and cheaper. hcloud API for servers; DNS stays at the registrar.

title: Take-over form: real backend instead of composed Telegram message
body: v1 composes a message the visitor pastes into Telegram. When the MCP engine exists, post to it and store the lead.

title: Landing: mobile nav (section links are hidden under 1040px)
body: The three section links disappear on tablet/phone. Add a compact menu or inline anchors under the hero.

title: Add Spanish translation to the landing
body: One dictionary in the script + one <option>. Copy is ~90 strings.

title: Decide: keep 'five minutes' tagline or soften
body: Reality is 5 min clicking + 10 min unattended + DNS wait. The fine-print line under the CTAs is honest; the headline is generous.

title: MCP engine: design the tool surface
body: Which steps of SKILL.md become MCP tools callable from the site's take-over flow; what stays human. Starts only after paying take-over requests exist.
